description: This file defines theming functions for a frontend project, including a color palette and styling tokens for the Ocean Professional theme, as well as functions to generate and map categorical color palettes based on this theme.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns an object containing theme tokens such as colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette seeded from Ocean theme colors to be used for categorical data, ensuring contrast and distinction for up to 'count' categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category labels to colors, assigning colors from the categorical palette in a consistent order.
